maya: Hey all :wave: quick question for folks starting today — where's the best place to drop setup/readme questions vs product/team questions? also how do i opt into the random/lunch bots without spamming?
kevin (people-ops): Welcome Maya! :tada: For onboarding/setup stuff, post in #new-hires first. If it's infra access or hardware, ping @lia in #eng-infra. Team-specific stuff -> the team's channel (e.g., #eng-runtime).
samira (devex): To add bot subs, you can DM the bot or use the slash commands. For example: `/subscribe lunch-club` or `/join random` (depends on the bot). I put a short guide in the onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/handbook/onboarding -> 'Bots & Subscriptions' section.
eng-bot: automated message: New user maya joined #new-hires. Recommended read: onboarding checklist (links sent).
onboard-buddy:jon: also, you can @mention me here or drop questions in a thread under your original message so we don't flood the channel. Threads are preferred when asking follow-ups.
maya: perfect, thanks! one more — do we have rules about posting logs or stack traces in public channels? sometimes my error messages have tokens/ids in them.
lia (infra): don't paste credentials or raw logs with secrets. scrub tokens or use a gist (set to private) and link, or post in #help with a heads-up. If it's access-related (IAM/msg queue), open a ticket with infra instead.
samira (devex): quick etiquette bullets: 1) Use threads for follow-ups, 2) keep long config snippets in a fenced code block or a private gist, 3) if you need async help, drop the question + timezone so people can triage, 4) use emoji reactions for ack/thanks to reduce noise.
maya: nice — any way to mute noisy bot channels but still get important alerts?
kevin (people-ops): Yes — use channel notifications: click channel name > Notifications > 'Only mentions' or 'Nothing'. For important infra alerts we post to #eng-oncall (do not mute if you're on call). For social channels you can mute and still check once a day.
maya: got it, thanks everyone! i'll read the doc and DM jon if anything else. :smile:
